title: Panther portable intent bundle 1.2
description: Destination-independent export of reviewable browser-evidence drafts. Observed actions, unverified hypotheses, and proposed verification steps remain separate. Page-reported failures are observations of what the page's own error stream said, not verified defects. Friction signals are hypotheses about the recorded actions, not confirmed defects. Schema validation establishes structure, not truth, successful delivery, or permission to execute. No raw event payloads, image bytes, or local artifact paths belong in this bundle.

exported_at.description: Export creation time as Unix seconds, possibly fractional; not an evidence-verification time.

tickets.description: Drafts exported for human review. An empty array is valid when generation produced no proposals.

authority.description: Exporting or importing this artifact never authorizes execution or delivery. Destination-specific approval remains a separate operation.

identifier.description: Stable producer identity, not a filesystem path or a destination ticket number.

sourceUrl.description: Sanitized HTTP(S) source location, or an empty string when unavailable. Credentials are excluded. Schema validation cannot determine whether an arbitrary URL path or text is sensitive.

stated_goal.description: The person's supplied goal; an empty string means no goal was provided. It must not be treated as inferred intent.

capture_mode.description: Producer capture mode, currently events or video; empty for legacy captures without mode metadata.

start_time.description: Capture start as Unix seconds, possibly fractional.

end_time.description: Capture end as Unix seconds, possibly fractional. Consumers should additionally check end_time is not before start_time.

event_count.description: Total stored events, which may exceed the subset used to generate a draft.

screenshot_count.description: Number of captured screenshots, not a claim that an inference model analyzed them.

diagnostic_count.description: Number of page-reported failures recorded during this capture. A failure is what the page's own error stream said; it is not a verified defect.

friction.description: One possible-friction hypothesis derived from the recorded actions. It is a possibility about what happened, never a confirmed defect and never a permission to act. A draft generated before version 1.2 omits this field.

kind.description: The hypothesis channel. Current values are repeated_clicks and non_control_click.

detail.description: What was observed and what it might mean. It must not read as a confirmed diagnosis.

event_indices.description: 1-based indices of the recorded events this hypothesis was derived from.

hypothesis.description: Always true. A friction signal is a hypothesis; a producer that emits false is describing a confirmed defect, which this contract does not allow.

diagnostic.description: One page-reported failure. It records what the page disclosed, not a confirmed defect, a reproduction, or a reproduction of the reporter's intent. Older exports omit this field entirely.

kind.description: The failure channel the page reported through.

event_index.description: 1-based index of the recorded event this failure was observed at. In an exported draft this indexes the analysed event sequence used for generation, matching evidence_refs.

message.description: Bounded, redacted text the page reported. It is untrusted page output and is not a verified explanation.

status.description: HTTP status the page received. Present for http_error records only.

line.description: Reported line of the uncaught exception. Present for uncaught_exception records only.

column.description: Reported column of the uncaught exception. Present for uncaught_exception records only.

evidenceReference.description: Bounded evidence identifier only. Strings exclude local absolute paths and data/file URI prefixes. Object references contain no raw events or image content; timestamp units are stated by their field names.

event_index.description: 1-based index into the recorded event sequence used for generation.

frame_index.description: Producer frame identifier; resolve its index convention against the original capture.

timestamp.description: Legacy timestamp with unspecified units; do not assume milliseconds or seconds without producer context.

timestamp_seconds.description: Timestamp in seconds; resolve whether absolute or relative from the reference kind and original capture.

provenance.description: Bounded producer metadata. Legacy exports can omit mode, revision, and counts; absence means unknown. Observed mode summarizes recorded actions; AI mode supplies unverified proposals. Neither an origin label nor a confidence value grants execution authority.

origin.description: Current values are observed_evidence or unverified_proposal; older producers may supply labels such as model_proposal. An origin label alone does not verify a claim.

model.description: Configured local model identifier; null for evidence-only generation. Naming a model does not prove model invocation or output quality.

evidence_kind.description: Current producer uses observed_events even for AI proposals: the observations and proposed issue remain distinct.

proposal_verified.description: The current producer emits false. A true legacy value is only a provenance assertion, not proof of validation or permission to execute.

created_at.description: Optional legacy producer timestamp. Consult the producer for string format or numeric units.

confidence.description: Optional uncalibrated producer confidence; it must not be treated as evidence that a bug exists.

media_analyzed.description: Whether media frames were analyzed for this generation. Captured screenshots or exported frame references alone do not imply analysis.

diagnostic_count.description: Number of page-reported failures in the capture this draft was generated from. It is not a count of verified defects.

description.description: Draft description or stated goal. For AI drafts it is explicitly an unverified proposal, not a confirmed defect.

hypothesis.description: Unverified proposed explanation or issue. Current observed-only generation leaves this empty; it must remain separate from observed evidence.

steps_to_reproduce.description: Steps summarized from observed actions. They do not establish that a failure occurred or that an issue has been reproduced.

suggested_verification_steps.description: Proposed future checks, especially model-generated instructions. These steps are not recorded observations or proof that a check ran.

acceptance_criteria.description: Proposed conditions for future acceptance; an empty list means they still need to be defined.

desired_behavior.description: Stated or proposed desired behavior; empty when unknown. Consult provenance and stated_goal to distinguish the person's intent from a model suggestion.

priority.description: Proposed priority label; current generation emits low, medium, or high. This is not scheduling or execution authority.

evidence.description: Observed-context summary. Recorded actions alone cannot prove that a proposed bug exists.

diagnostics.description: Page-reported failures relevant to this draft. They are observations of what the page said, never a verified defect. A draft generated before version 1.1 omits this field.

friction.description: Possible-friction hypotheses derived from the recorded actions. They are not confirmed defects. A draft generated before version 1.2 omits this field.

screenshot_timestamps.description: Legacy frame offsets in seconds. These are references only, with no image content and no assertion that media was analyzed.
